title: •General Veers
caption: •General Veers (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}, 4: Blizzard 1. While piloting an AT-AT, draws two battle destiny if unable to otherwise. While piloting a combat vehicle, its immunity to attrition is +2.
lore: General Maximilian Veers is the model of an Imperial Army officer. Cunning, loyal and a ruthlessly efficient *leader*. In charge of the ground assault troops in Vader’s forces.
